newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Motta calls for reform referendum-paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Motta calls for reform referendum-paper.

text.p: Brazilian Communications Minister Sergio Motta has proposed holding a referendum next year on political reforms he believes will never be approved by Congress, a newspaper said.
Motta said a referendum on the reforms, which are unlikely to be approved by Congress because of political interests, should be held alongside general elections next year, O GLobo said.
"We are not in a condition anymore to govern this country within the current political structure," O Globo quoted Motta as saying.
The three main points of the referendum should be party faithfulness, the representation of states in the lower house of Congress and campaign financing, according to Motta.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
